page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It does not feature any GPU accelerators, making it strictly a CPU-and-memory-focused resource.

The high memory density of the ecs.r5.8xlarge makes it suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications. From a resource-density perspective, the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides qualitative cost efficiency for applications that require large memory footprints without needing the higher compute costs associated with scaling up to instances with more vCPUs.
